sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS parentProductSku, p.ProductName AS name, ev.v1Sku AS variantSku, ev.v1Sku AS variant1Sku, ev.v1Name AS variant1Name, ev.v1A1 AS variant1Attr1, ev.v1A2 AS variant1Attr2, ev.v1A3 AS variant1Attr3, ev.v2Sku AS variant2Sku, ev.v2Name AS variant2Name, ev.v2A1 AS variant2Attr1, ev.v2A2 AS variant2Attr2, ev.v2A3 AS variant2Attr3, ev.v3Sku AS variant3Sku, ev.v3Name AS variant3Name, ev.v3A1 AS variant3Attr1, ev.v3A2 AS variant3Attr2, ev.v3A3 AS variant3Attr3, ao.addOnProductId AS addOnProductId, ao.addOnSku AS addOnSku FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalProfile anon ON anon.PortalId = po.PortalId AND anon.IsDefaultAnonymousProfile = @anonymousProfile CROSS APPLY (SELECT COUNT(r.SKU) AS cnt, MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn = @n1 THEN r.SKU END) AS v1Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn = @n1 THEN r.ProductName END) AS v1Name, MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn = @n1 THEN av.a1 END) AS v1A1, MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn = @n1 THEN av.a2 END) AS v1A2, MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn = @n1 THEN av.a3 END) AS v1A3, MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn = @n2 THEN r.SKU END) AS v2Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn = @n2 THEN r.ProductName END) AS v2Name, MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn = @n2 THEN av.a1 END) AS v2A1, MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn = @n2 THEN av.a2 END) AS v2A2, MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn = @n2 THEN av.a3 END) AS v2A3, MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn = @n3 THEN r.SKU END) AS v3Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn = @n3 THEN r.ProductName END) AS v3Name, MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn = @n3 THEN av.a1 END) AS v3A1, MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn = @n3 THEN av.a2 END) AS v3A2, MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn = @n3 THEN av.a3 END) AS v3A3 FROM (SELECT s.PimProductId, s.SKU, s.ProductName, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SKU) AS rn FROM (SELECT v.PimProductId, v.SKU, v.ProductName FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct v ON v.PimProductId = a.PimProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU = v.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 COALESCE(pr.SalesPrice, pr.RetailPrice) AS price FROM dbo.ZnodePriceList pl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePrice pr ON pr.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListProfile plf ON plf.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId AND plf.PortalProfileId = anon.PortalProfileID LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plo ON plo.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId AND plo.PortalId = po.PortalId WHERE pr.SKU = v.SKU AND (plf.PriceListProfileId IS NOT NULL OR plo.PriceListPortalId IS NOT NULL) AND ISNULL(pl.ActivationDate, @now) <= @now AND ISNULL(pl.ExpirationDate, @now) >= @now AND ISNULL(pr.ActivationDate, @now) <= @now AND ISNULL(pr.ExpirationDate, @now) >= @now ORDER BY CASE WHEN plf.PriceListProfileId IS NOT NULL THEN @profileListRank ELSE @storeListRank END, plf.Precedence, plo.Precedence, pl.PriceListId) gp WHERE a.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId AND v.IsActive = @isActive AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId AND gp.price > @zero AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT xa.PimAttributeId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue xv INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute xa ON xa.PimAttributeId = xv.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeDefaultValue xd ON xd.PimAttributeValueId = xv.PimAttributeValueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimConfigureProductAttribute xc ON xc.PimAttributeId = xa.PimAttributeId AND xc.PimProductId = p.PimProductId WHERE xv.PimProductId = v.PimProductId AND CHARINDEX(@sep + xa.AttributeCode + @sep, @sep + @variantAttributes + @sep) > @zero) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT yc.PimAttributeId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimConfigureProductAttribute yc INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute ya ON ya.PimAttributeId = yc.PimAttributeId WHERE yc.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND CHARINDEX(@sep + ya.AttributeCode + @sep, @sep + @variantAttributes + @sep) > @zero) GROUP BY v.PimProductId, v.SKU, v.ProductName HAVING SUM(i.Quantity) >= @quantityUsed) s) r OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN o.pos = @n1 THEN o.val END) AS a1, MAX(CASE WHEN o.pos = @n2 THEN o.val END) AS a2, MAX(CASE WHEN o.pos = @n3 THEN o.val END) AS a3 FROM (SELECT COALESCE(dl.AttributeDefaultValue, dv.AttributeDefaultValueCode) AS val, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CHARINDEX(@sep + oa.AttributeCode + @sep, @sep + @variantAttributes + @sep)) AS pos FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue ov INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute oa ON oa.PimAttributeId = ov.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeDefaultValue od ON od.PimAttributeValueId = ov.PimAttributeValueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValue dv ON dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId = od.PimAttributeDefaultValueId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValueLocale dl ON dl.PimAttributeDefaultValueId = dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId AND dl.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE ov.PimProductId = r.PimProductId AND CHARINDEX(@sep + oa.AttributeCode + @sep, @sep + @variantAttributes + @sep) > @zero) o) av) ev OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 ac.PimProductId AS addOnProductId, ac.SKU AS addOnSku FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddonGroup g ON g.PimAddonGroupId = ap.PimAddonGroupId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProductDetail d ON d.PimAddOnProductId = ap.PimAddOnProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct ac ON ac.PimProductId = d.PimChildProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePrice xp ON xp.SKU = ac.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList xl ON xl.PriceListId = xp.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal xo ON xo.PriceListId = xl.PriceListId WHERE ap.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND xo.PortalId = po.PortalId AND xp.RetailPrice > @zero AND ISNULL(xl.ActivationDate, @now) <= @now AND ISNULL(xl.ExpirationDate, @now) >= @now AND ISNULL(xp.ActivationDate, @now) <= @now AND ISNULL(xp.ExpirationDate, @now) >= @now AND (@addOnDisplayType IS NULL OR g.DisplayType = @addOnDisplayType) AND ac.IsActive = @isActive ORDER BY ap.DisplayOrder, ap.PimAddOnProductId, d.DisplayOrder, ac.SKU) ao WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND ev.cnt >= @minVariants AND (SELECT SUM(LEN(x.code) + LEN(@sep)) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ca.AttributeCode AS code FROM dbo.ZnodePimConfigureProductAttribute cpa INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute ca ON ca.PimAttributeId = cpa.PimAttributeId WHERE cpa.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND CHARINDEX(@sep + ca.AttributeCode + @sep, @sep + @variantAttributes + @sep) > @zero) x) = LEN(@variantAttributes) + LEN(@sep) AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ap.PimAddOnProductId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddonGroup g ON g.PimAddonGroupId = ap.PimAddonGroupId WHERE ap.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND (@addOnDisplayType IS NULL OR g.DisplayType = @addOnDisplayType) AND EXISTS (SELECT d.PimAddOnProductDetailId FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProductDetail d INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct ac ON ac.PimProductId = d.PimChildProductId WHERE d.PimAddOnProductId = ap.PimAddOnProductId AND ac.IsActive = @isActive)) >= @minAddOns AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.PimAttributeId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute pa ON pa.PimAttributeId = av.PimAttributeId WHERE av.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND pa.IsPersonalizable = @isPersonalizable AND (@personalizationAttribute IS NULL OR pa.AttributeCode = @personalizationAttribute)) >= @minPersonalizableAttributes AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) AND (@minAddOns = @zero OR ao.addOnProductId IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT e.SKU FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity e INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity w ON w.VersionId = e.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog k ON k.PublishCatalogId = e.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE e.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND k.PortalId = po.PortalId AND w.RevisionType = @publishState AND w.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND e.IsActive = @isActive AND e.IsObsolete = @false AND e.ProductIndex >= @n1) AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.PimAddOnProductId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct q WHERE q.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND q.RequiredType = @required) <= @minAddOns AND CHARINDEX(@sp, p.SKU) = @zero ORDER BY p.SKU
